LESSON: READING ALOUD: PHONETIC AWARENESS PRONUNCIATION PHRASING VOICE PROJECTION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: FRENCH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which places is reading aloud done?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognize words in context when reading
2. read aloud simple words with accurate pronunciation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING ALOUD: PHONETIC AWARENESS PRONUNCIATION PHRASING VOICE PROJECTION
This lesson teaches Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection for Grade 4 FRENCH.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognize words in context when reading
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. read aloud simple words with accurate pronunciation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection above.
2. Explain Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading aloud: Phonetic awareness Pronunciation Phrasing Voice projection important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
